# HIMLoco Reference Notice

The HIM estimator/actor data flow and swapped prototype objective were adapted from
IsaacZH/himloco_lab commit `c3fbd0173f2a53a86e472c099f8e2e9744cf7639`, which in
turn references HIMLoco. The referenced Python algorithm files carry the BSD
3-Clause NVIDIA/ETH Zurich notice. This project rewrites the integration for RSL-RL
5's TensorDict model/algorithm API and does not vendor the reference repository.

References:

- https://github.com/IsaacZH/himloco_lab
- https://github.com/InternRobotics/HIMLoco
- https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_mujoco
- https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_sdk2_python
